If you are reading this, thank you for having interest in what I am about to say. It will be very long.

Today I have taken one step closer to dying and I have passed the mid-20 age.

children.text: To be honest ever since my graduation in March, I have not been doing well mentally and financially. I thought I would be able to find a job immediately in the media industry but never have I been so wrong.

I faced several rejections from companies or they have never replied to my emails.

Hence, I tried to start opening myself for art commissions. I know it in myself that I dont think anyone would like my art. And as expected, no one is interested in commissioning me.
I begun to get really worried on the outlook of my life. I plunged into deep depression after having that thought. I was not earning money and time goes by just like that.
The more days and weeks went by, the more deeper I sink into darkness. I dont want to have second thoughts like "Why did I choose this path?" because I loved drawing. I really do.

I tried not to trouble my friends and family about my problems. They might have so much on their plates already. I tried to face the darkness on my own. Eventually I reached a breaking point where I reluctantly told a handful of my closed ones the problems I was facing.
Some of them told me to relax and etc. But one of them actually had the patience to sit down with me and properly discussed about what I have been facing and their opinions on how I should face them.

It boosted my courage to move forward and regained my ability to solve problems with a level-headed mindset. I also begun to see clearly now the ones that mattered most to me. I want to thank those who helped me in my darkest times.

he month of May arrived and I cant say enough that I am blessed and I loved to be born in that month. After 2 years (due to studies) I finally passed my driving test and I am now street legal. Then, I went into my pixiv account and realized that I have received a mail.

The mail was sent by a person who wished to commission me for a fan-art. It was my first commission request received I was extremely overjoyed that I worked on it immediately and finished it. You can see the artwork here: https://t.co/ZWXlBC85hb

Reaching here on the 23rd of May. I am surprised that I am still alive for 26 years. Life sucks but I am going to build my strength and face the problems. I dont want to let down the people who have been believing in me.
I will do it my own way and do my best. I want to create works that brings joy to others. Both illustration and music.

Also in this trying times, please keep yourself healthy, practice good personal hygiene, and be considerate to others. The more we do that, the faster we could curb the pandemic and bring the normal life back again.
Because I want to perform for all of you guys in real life again. I want to travel and perform overseas again. I want to see everyone on the dancefloor again.

I sincerely thank the ones who have been supporting me so far and I hope that you would continue to support me no matter what I do. I genuinely appreciate it very much.

Thank you.
